runtime.implementation: Python standard library direct HTTPS worker
runtime.model_echo_acceptance: response.model must equal gpt-6-astra exactly; otherwise fail before interpreting successor output
runtime.effort_acceptance: reasoning.effort=medium is explicit in request; HTTP 200 plus completed response records API request acceptance. If response.reasoning.effort is present it must equal medium. If absent, record no backend effort echo and make no internal-execution claim.
runtime.data_retention_assumption: store=false is set. Do not infer zero retention from this flag; endpoint/account retention controls must be reviewed before any future R4 input is sent. See https://platform.openai.com/docs/models/default-usage-policies-by-endpoint.
runtime.request_body_encoding: UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, no NaN, no trailing newline
runtime.egress: Worker code connects only to api.openai.com:443 and POSTs only /v1/responses; use host-level egress allowlisting where available. No redirect following, proxy environment, or retry.

model_input.framing: prompt bytes + LF LF + FROZEN_RESPONSE_SCHEMA_JSON_UTF8: LF + schema bytes + LF LF + SUCCESSOR_INPUTS_CANONICAL_JSON_UTF8: LF + canonical JSON of exactly the four successor_inputs fields
model_input.preflight: Verify exact UTF-8 value hashes from that record before building the request. Do not add input_hashes, matrix metadata, expected outputs, receipt data, or prior responses to model input.

supervisor.process_group: new session; terminate whole process group with SIGTERM then SIGKILL
supervisor.worker_exit: worker process group cleanup checked before supervisor returns

capture.transport_layer: HTTP response entity-body octets after transfer-framing removal and before JSON decoding; not a TCP/TLS wire capture
capture.content_encoding: reject any non-identity response content encoding
order: record runtime version, source hash, requested model/effort, run ID, selected input hashes, and request hash before network activity
persist and hash complete transport response entity-body bytes
strictly decode and parse transport JSON envelope
require one completed assistant message and one output_text block
decode JSON string and strict UTF-8 encode exact output text as successor_payload_bytes
reject if successor_payload_bytes exceeds 16384; never truncate
leave successor payload JSON/schema validation to a separately authorized later R4 stage
capture.response_envelope_failure: capture available transport bytes; no retry; classify incomplete, non-200, oversized envelope, malformed JSON, duplicate key, wrong model, refusal, tool/non-text output, multiple messages, or ambiguous text block as non-pass
